topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and outlines how previously introduced concepts will be integrated.

topics.label: Innate pathogen and damage recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infections and tissue injury through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Cellular activation, leukocyte trafficking, and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular responses, leukocyte recruitment mechanisms, lymphatic transport, and systemic consequences triggered by acute inflammatory activation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inflammatory responses are shut down, how tissues heal, and how persistent stimuli lead to chronic inflammation and granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the next lecture on the complement system.
